chapter_name: Verghese Kurien: I Too Had A Dream
learning_objective: 🎯 Get inspired by the 'Milkman of India' and discover how one person's vision and teamwork can magically transform a whole nation!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Meet Dr. Verghese Kurien, the genius who dreamed of making India the largest milk producer in the world. He saw that poor farmers were being cheated and decided to change the system completely.
He started the 'Amul' cooperative movement. Instead of working alone, millions of farmers joined hands. This teamwork gave them the strength to earn a fair price and live better lives.
Through hard work and smart planning, Dr. Kurien's dream brought happiness and prosperity to rural India. It teaches us that business can be used for social good, not just for profit.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ My Big Dream Vision Board
fun_activity.instructions: If you could start a giant project to help people in your country, what would it be? Write down your big idea and draw a logo for your new helpful organization!

quick_recap: ⭐ Dr. Verghese Kurien is known as the father of the White Revolution in India.
⭐ He empowered millions of poor dairy farmers by uniting them into cooperatives.
⭐ His journey proves that when we dream for the benefit of others, incredible things happen.
